summary: Iteration 14 — Native ARIADNI Meetings/Calendar E2E. Found & fixed one CRITICAL backend bug: GET /api/admin/meetings?filter=today|upcoming crashed 500 due to list+tuple concatenation (`list(ACTIVE_STATUSES) + ('rescheduled',)`), which meant the whole /meetings dashboard was broken for the two most-used tabs. Fixed by changing tuple to list. All 14 backend pytest cases now PASS (booking config, slots, book, slot-removal, 409 double-book, manage GET/reschedule/cancel, all 4 admin-meetings filters incl. rescheduled row visible, PATCH status=completed + lead timeline meeting_completed, meeting-types CRUD, availability PUT round-trip, external-only card regression). Frontend E2E on /feras-askar: cta-exchange-button + cta-book-button both visible & gold-themed (rgb 201,162,75), no console errors, 0px horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390. Exchange flow → exchange-dialog → exchange-success + exchange-savecontact + CRM lead created (source seen in admin/leads). Booking flow → 3 seeded meeting types → dates → 18 slots (Aug 12 weekday) → book-success with book-manage-link + Copy. /m/{token} manage page: manage-reschedule picks date+slot & succeeds, manage-cancel sets status=cancelled. Admin /meetings page: meetings-link in header, meetings-page loads with all 4 tabs (today/upcoming/past/cancelled), booked meeting shows under Upcoming with meeting-{id} + meeting-status-{id} SELECT; changing status to completed toasts 'Marked completed' and PATCHes 200 with CRM timeline meeting_completed. AI /api/ai/followup endpoint returns a valid draft (verified via curl). Owner Booking editor tab on /admin edit: booking-native-toggle, booking-timezone, mt-add, 3 mt-title-* rows, 7 avail-day-*, avail-start, avail-end, avail-save all present; admin-save-button visible. No console errors anywhere. All TEST_ leads deleted; test meetings cancelled; feras-askar untouched (status=published).

minor.issue: A meeting with status='completed' but future start_utc is invisible on ALL tabs (upcoming filters out completed; past requires start<now; cancelled requires status=cancelled). Real-world impact is small because owners only mark completed after the meeting time — but the AI Draft follow-up button (which requires status=completed) can only be reached from Past. Consider (a) including status=completed in Upcoming until start<now, OR (b) a dedicated 'Completed' tab.

action_items: (minor UX) Decide whether a meeting marked 'completed' but with future start_utc should stay in Upcoming or appear in a dedicated 'Completed' tab. Currently it disappears from every tab, hiding the AI 'Draft follow-up' button.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL FIXED: /app/backend/server.py admin_meetings() lines 972,975 concatenated `list(ACTIVE_STATUSES) + ('rescheduled',)` — TypeError, so both filter=today and filter=upcoming returned 500. Changed the tuple to a list. Add a lint/test guard so this can't regress silently.

PATCH /api/admin/meetings/{id}/status accepts a 'rescheduled' status from the client and stores it — but this event is normally produced by the guest reschedule flow. Consider narrowing the admin-writable status set to {scheduled,confirmed,completed,cancelled,no-show}.
Cancelled meetings are never fully deleted; the 'blocked slot' logic ignores them via ACTIVE_STATUSES which is correct. Good.

BookMeetingDialog useEffect resets state on `open` but keeps stale types when the dialog is re-opened quickly after another dialog closes; consider also resetting types=[] before the GET to avoid a brief flash of the previous card's types when navigating between cards on the same session.

The 21-day date carousel in BookMeetingDialog surfaces every day including weekends & past dates before min-notice; buttons still render — they just yield empty slots. Consider disabling non-working days visually to avoid a dead click.

Reminders and Google/Outlook sync stored as `NOT_CONFIGURED` in meeting.reminders — good architecture, no bug. Please add a UI badge on the meeting card explaining 'reminders not configured' to set expectations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The admin_meetings list+tuple bug was fixed at server.py L972,L975 — regression covered by test_admin_meetings_all_filters. Future testers: pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported OR run via `env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep ...) pytest`; use `-o addopts=''` to bypass xdist which the sandbox pytest.ini enables by default. The AI 'Draft follow-up' button is only visible when meeting.status='completed'; to test it end-to-end on the UI, mark completed WHILE the meeting is on the Upcoming tab, then flip to Past — but currently a completed+future meeting falls into no tab (see minor UX issue). To validate AI generation without that, POST /api/ai/followup directly.
rca of the issue: server.py L972/L975 built the Mongo $in filter with `list(ACTIVE_STATUSES) + ('rescheduled',)`. ACTIVE_STATUSES is a tuple, wrapped with list(), so the LHS was a list and RHS a tuple → Python raises TypeError. Every call to /admin/meetings?filter=today or filter=upcoming hit this line unconditionally, returning HTTP 500 and rendering the /meetings dashboard's most-used tabs unusable. Fix: replace `('rescheduled',)` with `['rescheduled']`. Reproduction (pre-fix): `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' <BASE>/api/admin/meetings?filter=upcoming` → 500 + stacktrace `TypeError: can only concatenate list (not "tuple") to list`. Verified fix returns 200 with a list of meetings.
